scripts.lint: pnpm lint:format:check && node packages/config/env.mjs && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings && node scripts/check-lines.mjs && pnpm lint:effect && pnpm lint:typecheck
scripts.lint:effect: effect-tsgo diagnostics --project apps/api/tsconfig.json --severity error && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project packages/auth/tsconfig.json --severity error && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project apps/infra/tsconfig.json --severity error
scripts.plan:dev: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @starter/infra plan --stage dev --profile default --env-file ../../packages/config/.env.dev
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @starter/infra deploy --stage dev --profile default --env-file ../../packages/config/.env.dev
scripts.plan:prod: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @starter/infra plan --stage prod --profile prod --env-file ../../packages/config/.env.prod
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @starter/infra deploy --stage prod --profile prod --env-file ../../packages/config/.env.prod
